title: Observation Before Prediction
summary: Understand the present before reasoning about the future. Prediction without understanding is speculation.

title: Momento Kernel
summary: Stable foundation: Round Event Model, database layer, schema contracts, runtime, event bus, API contracts, engine registry.

title: Immutable Raw Events
summary: Raw data is never edited. Corrections recorded separately. Enables replay, auditing, calibration, learning.

title: Intelligence Engine Chain
summary: Pattern -> DNA -> Similarity -> Probability -> Confidence -> Forecast. Each replaceable with clear contracts.

title: Explainability Metadata
summary: Every prediction states inputs used, patterns detected, conclusion reasoning, confidence, and uncertainty drivers.

title: Local vs Production Independence
summary: SQLite/local dev must always keep working when cloud (Vercel/Render/Supabase) support is added.
